description: This file defines React functional components for displaying product cards and a product grid in a furniture marketplace application. It includes type definitions for products and component props, rendering logic for product images, titles, and prices, and links for navigation.

methods.name: ProductCard
methods.description: A React component that displays individual product details, including image, title, price, and a link to the product page.

methods.name: ProductGrid
methods.description: A React component that renders a grid layout of multiple products using the ProductCard component.
